notes: VIDEOGAME ADAPTATION (designer spec, Oct 2026: Unified Character Architecture): every character belongs to a faction. Faction is character data; it is not who controls the character (player / AI) or how they feel about the away team (disposition, awareness), which belong to the world actor.

creatorFaction: the faction of every character made in the character creator (the Federation / TOS demo direction). The creator has no faction choice; exports from before schema 0.9.0 carry no faction and are read as this one.
